SELECT * FROM ( SELECT A.*, ROWNUM AS RNUM FROM ( SELECT M.MENU_CD, M.MENU_NM, M.MENU_URL, M.UP_MENU_CD, M.SORT_ORD, M.USE_YN, ( SELECT LISTAGG(AUTH_CD, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY AUTH_CD) FROM TB_MENU_AUTH WHERE MENU_CD = M.MENU_CD ) AS authNames FROM TB_MENU M
ORDER BY M.UP_MENU_CD ASC, M.SORT_ORD ASC, M.MENU_CD ASC ) A WHERE ROWNUM <= #{offset} + #{size} ) WHERE RNUM > #{offset}

SELECT M.MENU_CD, M.MENU_NM, M.MENU_URL, M.UP_MENU_CD, M.SORT_ORD, M.USE_YN, ( SELECT LISTAGG(AUTH_CD, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY AUTH_CD) FROM TB_MENU_AUTH WHERE MENU_CD = M.MENU_CD ) AS authNames FROM TB_MENU M ORDER BY M.UP_MENU_CD ASC, M.SORT_ORD ASC, M.MENU_CD ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_MENU (MENU_CD, MENU_NM, MENU_URL, UP_MENU_CD, SORT_ORD, REG_ID, USE_YN) VALUES (#{menuCd}, #{menuNm}, #{menuUrl}, #{upMenuCd}, #{sortOrd}, #{regId}, #{useYn})
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_MENU SET MENU_NM = #{menuNm}, MENU_URL = #{menuUrl}, UP_MENU_CD = #{upMenuCd}, SORT_ORD = #{sortOrd}, USE_YN = #{useYn} WHERE MENU_CD = #{menuCd}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_MENU_AUTH (MENU_CD, AUTH_CD, REG_ID) VALUES (#{menuCd}, #{authCd}, #{regId})
